title_suffix: finer certified endpoints (1e-200) and deeper outer witness on PR1424 (60 bootstrap steps, eta=beta=1e-130, kappa grid 1e-122); construction unchanged
summary: PR1424's construction is unchanged. The certified complex endpoints (native and conservative) are refined from the inherited 1e-24 bracket to 1e-200: the retained engines still certify the 1e-24 bracket, and finer-constant copies of both rational engines certify accept at the endpoint and reject at endpoint+1e-200. The outer witness settings are deepened (bootstrap steps 60, eta = beta = 1e-130, backoff 1e-133, final kappa grid 1e-122) and the decimal fields are exact. kappa moves from 0.001676855229071321886206381217337893 to 0.00167685522907132188620645677227459261951244873951047526280336519105115665521200964951578469164138454299292754381039421806.
